messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images. Match the shape and styling of the hair in the reference images, while retaining the current person's facial features, hair color, and clothing. Leave the rest of the video unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images. Match the shape and styling of the hair in the reference images, while retaining the current person's facial features, hair color, and clothing. Leave the rest of the video unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"He stands on a sidewalk, then bends forward and swings his arms in a dance-like motion before straightening back up.","camera":"The camera is static at a medium distance, framing the man from the thighs up in a side profile view.","clothing":"He wears a light gray-and-white plaid button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, brown leather suspenders, and dark trousers with a belt.","hair_color":"White.","hairstyle":"He has a white pompadour with closely shaved sides.","identity":"A young Black man with a slim build and short facial hair is shown in profile and three-quarter views.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor city street in front of a dark storefront with large windows displaying text such as 'SOAP' and 'COCOA POWDER' behind red curtains."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The original white top-knot/bun hairstyle was replaced with a white pompadour/quiff with closely shaved sides. The person's face, white hair color, plaid shirt, suspenders, trousers, street scene, and dance-like motion remain largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's hairstyle to match the reference images, preserving facial features, white hair color, and clothing while leaving the rest of the video unchanged.
uncertain: Whether the new hairstyle precisely matches the reference images' shape and styling is uncertain because the reference shows black hair and the output retains white hair as requested.
